_comment: One registry for every agent job-agent supports. scripts/gen-plugins.mjs turns it into agents/<id>.md (the steps for that agent, with its setup message) and agents/README.md. Edit this file, then run npm run gen:plugins.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.signIn: Run `claude mcp login trueinterview` (or type `/mcp` inside Claude Code and pick trueinterview).

keyConfig.where: Run in your terminal. It replaces an earlier trueinterview entry.
keyConfig.text: claude mcp remove trueinterview --scope user 2>/dev/null; claude mcp add --scope user --transport http trueinterview {{URL}} --header "Authorization: Bearer {{KEY}}"

agents.note: Runs when you ask. For a repeating run, use `/loop` inside Claude Code.

agents.label: Codex

keyConfig.where: Paste at the end of ~/.codex/config.toml (the Codex app and CLI share it), replacing any earlier [mcp_servers.trueinterview] block, then restart Codex.

agents.runPrompt: Run my job search now. Use the browser to apply on company sites; for a site that needs me signed in, use Chrome, and list any role waiting on a sign-in instead of dropping it.
agents.note: Runs when you ask. Applying needs a browser: turn on the Browser plugin in the Codex app, and the Codex Chrome extension for sites you are signed in to.

agents.label: Cursor
agents.signIn: Open Cursor Settings → Tools & MCP → trueinterview → Connect.

keyConfig.where: Cursor Settings → Tools & MCP → New MCP Server opens ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Add this entry inside "mcpServers" and save.

agents.note: Runs when you ask, in a new Agent-mode chat. It applies with Cursor's own browser.

agents.label: Gemini CLI
agents.signIn: Inside Gemini CLI, run `/mcp auth trueinterview`.

keyConfig.where: Add this entry inside "mcpServers" in ~/.gemini/settings.json and restart Gemini CLI.

agents.note: Runs when you ask. Applying needs a browser MCP (see docs/browser.md).

agents.label: OpenCode
agents.note: Runs when you ask. Applying needs a browser MCP (see docs/browser.md).

agents.label: Meta Muse

keyConfig.where: When Muse asks for the key in its secure credential prompt, paste it there. Never paste it into the chat.

agents.note: Runs in the cloud every day, even with your computer off.

agents.label: Manus

keyConfig.where: Paste the key into Manus's secure credential prompt. No prompt? Settings → Connectors → TrueInterview → Edit, and add the header `Authorization` with the value `Bearer <your key>`.

agents.note: Runs in the cloud every day. It applies in its own cloud browser; when a site needs you signed in, it asks you to take over that browser.

agents.label: Grok

keyConfig.where: Paste the key into Grok's secure credential prompt. No prompt? Open the TrueInterview connector's settings and add the header `Authorization` with the value `Bearer <your key>`.

agents.note: Runs every day on the schedule you set up with it.

agents.label: Qwen (千问办公)

keyConfig.where: In the 千问办公 desktop app: 扩展 → 连接器 → + 添加 → 粘贴 JSON 配置, paste this and import. Turn on its 浏览器 connector too: that is how it applies on company sites.

agents.note: Runs every day while your computer is on; a run is skipped while it is off or asleep.

agents.label: WorkBuddy

keyConfig.where: In the WorkBuddy desktop app: Connectors → Custom connectors → + Add MCP, paste this and save, then trust TrueInterview when it asks.

agents.note: Runs every day while your computer is on; a run is skipped while it is off or asleep.

agents.label: Another agent

keyConfig.where: Add TrueInterview as a remote MCP server ({{URL}}). If it offers a sign-in, sign in; otherwise give it the key in its credential or header settings (`Authorization: Bearer <your key>`), never in the chat.

agents.note: Any agent that can call a remote MCP server. If it can't schedule tasks, ask it to run when you want.
